about: Guided-study syllabus. Order and placement rationale: docs/GUIDED_STUDY.md. Content packs map their sections onto these unit ids; the ids are stable, titles may change.

units.title: Greetings, tú and usted, numbers
units.summary: Say hello, introduce yourself, choose tú or usted, count to 31.

units.title: Nouns with their article: gender, number, hay
units.summary: Learn every noun with el or la, make plurals, and say what there is with hay.

units.title: Subject pronouns and ser
units.summary: Who someone is, where they are from, what they do: yo soy, ella es, ser de.

units.title: Adjective agreement
units.summary: Make adjectives match their noun: la casa blanca, los libros nuevos.

units.title: Regular -ar verbs, questions, telling time
units.summary: Conjugate hablar-type verbs in the present, ask questions, say the time.

units.title: Tener, tener que, tener expressions
units.summary: Have things, have to do things, and tener hambre / sed / prisa.

units.title: Ir, ir a + place, ir a + infinitive
units.summary: Where you are going, and the everyday future: voy a estudiar.

units.title: -er and -ir verbs, family, possessives
units.summary: Finish the regular present, talk about family, mi / tu / su.

units.title: Estar for location; hay vs está
units.summary: Where things are: el gato está debajo de la mesa. Hay un gato vs el gato está.

units.title: Me gusta / me gustan; querer, poder, necesitar + infinitive
units.summary: Say what you like as a set phrase, and what you want, can and need to do.

units.title: Stem-changing verbs
units.summary: e→ie, o→ue, e→i: quiero, puedo, pido, and the boot pattern.

units.title: Estar with feelings and conditions; the present progressive
units.summary: Estoy cansado, estamos contentos; what is happening right now: estoy estudiando.

units.title: Yo-irregular verbs; saber vs conocer
units.summary: hago, tengo, salgo, digo, pongo; knowing facts vs knowing people and places.

units.title: Ser vs estar I: the core contrast
units.summary: Identity and description vs location and condition, once both verbs are familiar.

units.title: Personal a; para and por as set phrases
units.summary: Veo a María; para + purpose or destination; common por phrases.

units.title: Direct object pronouns: understand first, then use
units.summary: lo, la, los, las: who did what to whom in Lo ve María, then placing them yourself.

units.title: Reflexive verbs and daily routine
units.summary: Me levanto, te duchas, se acuesta: describing your day.

units.title: Comparatives, superlatives, demonstratives
units.summary: más alto que, tan grande como, el mejor; este, ese, aquel.

units.title: Preterite I: regular -ar verbs
units.summary: Completed past actions: hablé, trabajaste, llegó.

units.title: Preterite II: -er/-ir verbs; fue and fui
units.summary: comí, viviste, salió, and the shared forms of ser and ir.

units.title: Preterite III: stem changes and strong irregulars
units.summary: pidió, durmió; tuve, hice, dije, estuve, pude, puse, supe, quise, vine.

units.title: Indirect object pronouns
units.summary: me, te, le, nos, les with dar, decir, pedir: Le doy el libro.

units.title: Gustar-type verbs in full
units.summary: a mí me gusta, a Juan le gustan; encantar, interesar, doler, faltar, importar.

units.title: Imperfect forms: states and habits
units.summary: era, estaba, tenía, había, iba: how things were and what used to happen.

units.title: Imperfect for description and background
units.summary: Childhood, settings and ongoing actions: cuando era niño, vivíamos en...

units.title: Preterite vs imperfect I: foreground and background
units.summary: What happened against what was going on: Llovía cuando salí.

units.title: Preterite vs imperfect II: interruptions, meaning-changing verbs
units.summary: supe vs sabía, quise vs quería, conocí vs conocía; stories with both.

units.title: Present perfect
units.summary: he comido, has visto: recent past and life experience (used more in Spain).

units.title: Affirmative commands with pronouns
units.summary: habla, come, ven, dímelo; usted commands.

units.title: Double object pronouns and pronoun placement
units.summary: se lo doy; voy a dártelo / te lo voy a dar.

units.title: Indefinite and negative words; impersonal se
units.summary: algo, nada, alguien, nadie, nunca; se habla español.

units.title: Por vs para, systematically
units.summary: Cause, exchange, duration and route vs purpose, destination, deadline and recipient.

units.title: Complex sentences: creo que, dice que; relative pronouns
units.summary: Joining clauses with que, donde, lo que: the step before the subjunctive.

units.title: The future tense
units.summary: hablaré, tendrás, será; also guessing: ¿Dónde estará?

units.title: The conditional
units.summary: Polite requests and would: me gustaría, ¿podrías...?

units.title: Checkpoint: tell a story
units.summary: Past tenses, pronouns and agreement together, reviewed and mixed.

units.title: Present subjunctive: forms and wishes
units.summary: quiero que vengas, es importante que estudies, ojalá.

units.title: Negative and formal commands
units.summary: no hables, no lo hagas, hable usted: commands built on the subjunctive.

units.title: Subjunctive of emotion
units.summary: me alegra que, siento que, tengo miedo de que.

units.title: Doubt and denial vs belief
units.summary: creo que es vs no creo que sea; dudo que, es posible que.

units.title: Adverbial clauses
units.summary: cuando llegues, para que sepas, antes de que, hasta que: one conjunction at a time.

units.title: Relative clauses and the unknown
units.summary: busco a alguien que sepa: subjunctive for people and things that may not exist.

units.title: Ser vs estar II: meaning-changing adjectives
units.summary: ser listo vs estar listo, ser aburrido vs estar aburrido; ser for where events happen.

units.title: Pluperfect: sequencing past events
units.summary: había comido: what had already happened before another past event.

units.title: Imperfect subjunctive and sequence of tenses
units.summary: quería que vinieras, era importante que estudiaras.

units.title: Si-clauses and hypotheticals
units.summary: si tuviera tiempo, viajaría: imagining what is not true.

units.title: The many uses of se
units.summary: Accidents (se me olvidó), aspect (irse, comerse), becoming (ponerse, volverse) and passive se.

units.title: Capstone: subjects, register and style
units.summary: When to say yo and when to drop it, formal vs informal writing, and a final mixed review.
